project.name: TPaper
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Youthful SaaS tool for exam conversion — bright white base with indigo-to-cyan gradient accents, Inter + Noto Sans SC typography, playful yet refined card surfaces, energetic micro-interactions
project.designRead: B2C SaaS tool / students and educators / youthful vibrant refined / medium density / avoid corporate grey monotony

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: top navbar with logo left, nav links center, action buttons right; active link gets gradient underline
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: indigo #6366f1 primary with gradient to cyan/teal for hero and accents
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter + Noto Sans SC, 400/500/600/700 weights, 1.6 body line-height
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-first surfaces, shadows only on hover/elevation, max alpha 0.05 for static
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: gradient-filled primary CTA with white text, subtle hover lift; secondary CTA outlined
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: centered hero, left-aligned content, consistent 16/24px padding

pages.title: 首页
pages.visualNorthStar: Vibrant gradient hero with floating decorative shapes, clean feature cards below, asymmetric layout

continuityAnchors.sharedShell: top-navbar + footer identical across all pages
continuityAnchors.brandTreatment: gradient accent on logo, primary CTA uses gradient fill
continuityAnchors.surfaceLanguage: white cards on light grey bg, border-only at rest, subtle shadow on hover

pages.soulElement: Hero section uses animated gradient mesh background with floating geometric shapes (circles, triangles) — gives a youthful, energetic first impression
